audit_scope.name: audit_scope
audit_scope.using: "audit_logs"."company_id" = nullif(current_setting('app.company_id', true), '')::uuid AND ("audit_logs"."inventory_id" IS NULL OR "audit_logs"."inventory_id" = nullif(current_setting('app.inventory_id', true), '')::uuid)
audit_scope.withCheck: "audit_logs"."company_id" = nullif(current_setting('app.company_id', true), '')::uuid AND ("audit_logs"."inventory_id" IS NULL OR "audit_logs"."inventory_id" = nullif(current_setting('app.inventory_id', true), '')::uuid)

products_values_valid.name: products_values_valid
products_values_valid.value: "products"."minimum_stock" >= 0 AND "products"."minimum_stock" <> 'NaN'::numeric AND "products"."unit_cost" >= 0 AND "products"."unit_cost" <> 'NaN'::numeric AND length(trim("products"."sku")) > 0 AND length(trim("products"."name")) > 0 AND length(trim("products"."unit")) > 0

movements_delta_valid.name: movements_delta_valid
movements_delta_valid.value: "stock_movements"."quantity_delta" <> 'NaN'::numeric AND (("stock_movements"."type" = 'in' AND "stock_movements"."quantity_delta" > 0) OR ("stock_movements"."type" = 'out' AND "stock_movements"."quantity_delta" < 0) OR ("stock_movements"."type" = 'adjustment' AND "stock_movements"."quantity_delta" <> 0))
